summary.text: Jeff Stanek is the Republican candidate for the Montana House of Representatives, District 90, in the November 3, 2026 general election. A history teacher and Air Force veteran, he defeated incumbent Curtis Cochran in the June 2, 2026 Republican primary and has no listed major-party opponent.

paragraphs.text: Jeff Stanek served in the U.S. Air Force from 2008 to 2010, according to Ballotpedia.

He earned a high school diploma from South Medford High School, a bachelor's degree from the University of Montana Western in 2018 and a graduate degree from Western Governors University in 2021, and his career experience includes working as a history teacher.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a Christian, social studies teacher and Afghanistan veteran.
Stanek finished second to Curtis Cochran in the three-way June 4, 2024 Republican primary for House District 90, 33.9 percent to 38.7 percent.
In 2026 he defeated Cochran, then the incumbent, 62.0 percent to 38.0 percent, and Ballotpedia shows no Democratic primary and a general election in which he is the only listed candidate.
In the survey, Stanek said he wants less government control, regulation and taxation, and listed lowering property taxes and stopping the growth of government among his key messages.
He named property taxes, natural resource management and education choice as policy interests.
